pages.text: Three things I make before anything else, because everything else is made of them.$(br2)A $(l)Galvanic Jar$() holds a jolt: an organ grafted on with one wakes. $(l)Preserving Fluid$() keeps flesh from rotting, and things grow in it that should not. $(l)Catgut$() stitches living things to living things.
The ages have better ways to most of what I make. See $(l)Spoils of the Ages$().
